Package com.tangosol.io

Class SerializationLimitPolicy

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tangosol.io.SerializationLimitPolicy
  • public class SerializationLimitPolicy
extends Object
    Generic serializer-owned limits for serialized container structures.
